livia01.title: The Vigil
livia01.d01: Aurélia is still asleep. In the Temple of the Flame, no one ever truly sleeps.
livia01.d02: Lívia! Thank Vesta. You need to hear this before anyone else.
livia01.d03: Cláudia, you should be at your post.
livia01.d04: Tonight the flame bowed. Toward the floor, like someone listening to a voice calling from below. And then came the knocking. Under the altar. I swear by Vesta.
livia01.c01: Cláudia waits, with the red eyes of someone who hasn't slept.
livia01.c01.doctrine: "The flame does not bow, Cláudia. It burns. That is all it does."
livia01.c01.scold: "Rumors offend Vesta. Wash your face and go back to your post."
livia01.d05a: I know what the doctrine says. I also know what I heard.
livia01.d05b: There, by the altar stone. But it's all quiet now. It always goes quiet when someone comes to look.
livia01.d06: Domícia waits by the niche. She never calls for anyone; people simply end up going to her.
livia01.e01.hint: Go to Domícia, by the niche.
livia01.h.tablet.1: A wax tablet forgotten on the floor. The handwriting is Cláudia's, hurried:
livia01.h.tablet.2: "Vesta, let it have been only a dream. And if it wasn't, let someone believe me."
livia01.h.lamp.1: At the foot of the lamp, someone left sweet bread from the Vestalia, gone hard. Lívia looks away. She has never been able to eat festival bread again.
livia01.h.gate.1: The bronze gate. On the other side, Aurélia wakes: carts, street cries, goat bells. The Temple always keeps its back to the city.
livia01.d07: Lívia. You smell of oil and of a night badly slept.
livia01.d08: The third watch was quiet, Vestal Maxima.
livia01.d09: Was it? Good. Today the Augural College is sending an augur to the Temple. A routine visit, they say.
livia01.d10: Domícia looks at Lívia's hands, at the old scars, like someone checking an account that never balances.
livia01.g01.hand: Her hand trembles inside her sleeve.
livia01.g01.all: Raised the flame before Domícia and saw her fear.
livia01.g01.none: Raised the flame before Domícia and saw nothing.
livia01.g01a: Under the sleeve, Domícia's hand trembles. The Vestal Maxima, who has never trembled before anyone, is afraid. Lívia lowers the cup before she notices.
livia01.g01b: The flame shows nothing. Or Lívia doesn't know how to look yet.
livia01.g01c: Something in her goes cold. A prayer she knew by heart stumbles halfway through.
livia01.c02: The College doesn't usually visit anyone as a routine.
livia01.c02.ask: "Why would the College come now, of all times?"
livia01.d11a: The College comes when it pleases, and it always pleases at the wrong time.
livia01.d11b: I know you will. You always are.
livia01.d12: Go and prepare the flame. And, Lívia: if the flame says anything today, don't answer.
livia01.e02.hint: Carry the cup to the altar.
livia01.h.lamp2.1: The second lamp burns crooked. Lívia straightens it without thinking. Twenty years of Temple live in her hands.
livia01.h.crack.1: A thin crack in the floor, by the column. Lívia lays her palm on it. The stone is warm, like skin.
livia01.d13: The morning rite has three movements: the oil, the word and the gesture. Domícia taught that haste puts out more flames than wind.
livia01.mpour.hint: Pour the oil. Slowly, as Domícia taught.
livia01.mpour.uneven: Poured the oil in fits and starts.
livia01.d14a: Slowly. Like giving water to the sick.
livia01.d14u: In fits and starts. The flame stumbles, but it stays.
livia01.d14b: Too fast. The flame chokes, shrinks... and comes back.
livia01.c04.formula: "Vesta, who has no image, receive what is yours."
livia01.c04.own: A prayer of her own, in a low voice, that no one taught her.
livia01.d15a: The old words settle the flame like a hand on a shoulder.
livia01.d15b: No one taught those words. Even so, the flame leans in to hear them.
livia01.c05.low: Lower the cup to the stone.
livia01.c05.raise: Raise the cup above her head.
livia01.d16a: Lívia lowers the cup to the stone. The flame bends toward the floor, just as Cláudia said. And the stone answers.
livia01.d16b: Lívia raises the cup. From up high, the flame folds downward like a curious neck, looking at the floor. And the stone answers.
livia01.mmark.hint: The flame pulls the cup toward the stone, where she has knelt a thousand times.
livia01.mmark.eye: A circle cut by a line, like a closed eye.
livia01.mmark.all: Saw the mark hidden in the altar stone.
livia01.d17: An instant. Then, only stone. But Lívia knows what she saw, and so does the flame.
livia01.d19: New sandals on old marble. The augur arrives early, like someone hoping to catch others asleep.
livia01.d20: Pórcio Varrão, of the Augural College. Don't mind me, sisters. I've only come to look.
livia01.d21: A fine flame. Strong, for this hour of the morning.
livia01.c06: Tell me, priestess: did it waver last night?
livia01.c06.truth: "It wavered. It bent toward the floor. And it did it again just now."
livia01.c06.lie: "No, augur. The flame of Vesta does not waver."
livia01.c06.defer: "The Vestal Maxima can answer that better than I can."
livia01.d22a: Honesty. Rare in a temple. The College will remember this, priestess. One way or another.
livia01.d22b: It doesn't waver. Of course not.
livia01.d22b2: He looks at the flame for too long. Then he puts away his tablet without writing anything.
livia01.d22c: The flame is in my care, augur. If there were anything, I would know.
livia01.d22c2: That is exactly what worries me, Vestal Maxima.
livia01.d23: The augur leaves before noon. The mark on the stone doesn't come back. Lívia runs her hand over it twice, just to be sure.
livia01.d24: There are things the flame shows that the mouth must not repeat.
livia01.d25a: You told the truth to an augur. May Vesta protect you, girl, because I may not be able to.
livia01.d25b: You lied well. I still don't know whether that makes me proud or frightens me.
livia01.d25c: You passed the question to me. That's all right. I've carried heavier things for you.
livia01.d26: Domícia turns her back too soon. Lívia remembers the hand trembling under the sleeve and, for the first time, doesn't know if she wants to know why.
livia01.d26b: Domícia turns her back too soon. Now Lívia knows why she is afraid, and wishes she didn't.
livia01.t_gift: A routine visit. She doesn't believe it. She is hiding something, and the flame would show what.
livia01.t_gift.second: "Every time you look with the flame, girl, one prayer less comes out of you. Only look when you must."
livia01.gh: what does Domícia fear from the College?
livia01.d10b: Don't look at me like that. It's only a visit.
livia01.c02.fear: "Your hand is trembling, Domícia. What are you afraid of?"
livia01.d11c: ...The book of vows. There is a fault of mine in it, from twelve winters ago. You know which.
livia01.d11c2: A Chief Vestal with two faults is not forgiven. So today no one gives the College a second fault. Not me, not you.
livia01.d21seen: I saw it from the portico, when you raised it. It bent toward the floor.
livia01.d22bseen: Odd. From the portico, I would have sworn I saw the opposite.
